description: Returns stored public regional forecast accuracy, including observed-station or model-proxy truth lineage, data sufficiency, and eligibility. Takes either a region_id or an objective slug, which resolves to the accuracy region of the NWAC zone the objective is bound to. Informational only.

region_id.description: Public accuracy region identifier, for example pnw-olympics. Provide exactly one of region_id and slug.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives. It resolves to the accuracy region of the NWAC zone the objective is bound to. Provide exactly one of slug and region_id.

name: get_forecast_accuracy
